changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Fonctions de lecture typée des métadonnées.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.meta_texte(m jsonb, code text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $corps$ SELECT m ->> code $corps$

changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Conservation et activation du type de document ; suppression d'un type utilisé impossible.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.type_document ADD CONSTRAINT ck_type_document_duree_conservation CHECK (duree_conservation_mois IS NULL OR duree_conservation_mois BETWEEN 1 AND 1200)

ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.type_document ADD CONSTRAINT ck_type_document_point_depart CHECK (point_depart IN ('DATE_DOCUMENT', 'DATE_DEPOT', 'METADONNEE') AND ((point_depart = 'METADONNEE') = (point_depart_index_code IS NOT NULL)))

changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Échéance de conservation calculée par déclencheurs.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_document_echeance BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF type_document_id, date_document, metadonnees, created_at ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document_echeance()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_type_document_echeances AFTER UPDATE OF duree_conservation_mois, point_depart, point_depart_index_code ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.type_document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.type_document_echeances()
